title: Upload preview
summary: After the person picks photos, videos or a file: a preview with an optional caption, then send. Each item uploads encrypted through the SDK send queue and shows in the timeline at once with its progress.

localPath.description: The file in the app's temporary folder (copied from the picker).

kind.description: From the type the picker gives.

items.description: What the person picked, in order. At most 10 at once.

caption.description: One caption, on the first item.

phase.description: preparing: compressing, making thumbnails and reading width, height, length and blurhash.

prepare.effect: Images: re-encode to JPEG (HEIC to JPEG on iOS), strip the location and other metadata, scale by the chats setting bipe_chats_media_quality. Videos: transcode by the same setting. Files: as they are.

remove.effect: Drops it; with none left, closes.

send.effect: For each item that is not tooLarge: Timeline.sendAttachment with UploadParameters (source, caption on the first, in_reply_to when a reply is drafted) and AttachmentKind Image, Video or File with its info and thumbnail. Closes; the rows show sending, and cancel uses SendAttachmentJoinHandle.cancel.

cancel.effect: Closes and deletes the temporary files.

notes: Timeline.sendImage, sendVideo and sendFile are deprecated in the binding; use Timeline.sendAttachment.
bipe_app_media_too_large takes the limit formatted by the system (100 MB). A too-large item stays in the preview with the message and is not sent.
Removing the location from photos is a privacy default, not a setting.
Stickers do not use this screen (composer-stickers). Voice messages neither (composer-voice).
